title: A new device joins rooms whose invite no device of the user accepted
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.61 item 3: Agent::join_own_rooms joins every room of the account's Chats whose group holds a client of the user. A room another user added this user to holds the invited device's leaf from the Add, whether or not that device joined from the Welcome, so a new device joins a room that mimid-agent-jmap's invite policy (FromAllowed, Never) left pending on the other devices. Nothing in the group or the account records whether the invite was accepted. Options: (a) the bridge applies its invite policy to external joins too (needs a way to tell who added the user, which the participant list does not record); (b) an account-level record of accepted rooms (INVENTED: a JMAP property or Room/unbind of declined rooms, so their Chats are unbound and skipped); (c) accept it as is: being added by MLS Add is being in the room. Found while doing mimid-d464.
notes: Decided by Mark 2026-11-19: only accepted rooms. The agent records which rooms the user accepted (synced via the user's server so every device sees it); a new device joins by external Commit only those.
